shared_elements: curved/rounded organic forms in low relief
justification: A shows a frontal anthropomorphic figure with a large head, incised facial/body markings and a prominent disc-like circle on the torso arranged symmetrically about a vertical axis, while B shows a fragmentary scene of overlapping curved forms suggesting a boat or animals in a horizontal narrative band with a strip of small repeated signs below. Beyond both being shallow relief carving with some rounded shapes, there is no shared specific motif, no shared relationship between elements, and the compositional logic (single frontal symmetric figure vs. horizontal scene of profile forms) is quite different.
